basic_profile.bio: Passionate about sustainable living and skincare, I reside in Portland, Oregon, where I work as an environmental consultant. My interests include eco-friendly product innovations, natural skincare routines, and technology in sustainability. I dislike greenwashing and companies that prioritize profit over the planet. Typically online during evenings and weekends, I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy hiking in my free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science and have worked in the field for over five years. My expertise lies in sustainable practices and eco-friendly product development. I spend a lot of time researching and staying updated on the latest trends in environmental technology and sustainable skincare.
